issues.description: Unsigned local execution receipts and hashes assume trusted collector/storage, not external attestation. Python is independent of TS arithmetic/union, not formal theorem verification.
Observed synchronous checkpoints are not hard CPU preemption; child process additionally has a hard timeout. Old and new budgets fail closed without cap or source-domain expansion.
Read-only source transport results were exposed during SCAN before BUILD. This is not a blind benchmark, a mathematical novelty claim or a model capability score.
